facts.text: The autogenskills footer segment omits its context bar and the `Skill: none` placeholder; the test asserts the footer does not contain "Context" or "Skill: none" while still showing "Autogen 0/5".

Trebol's README documents an estimate-based context guard for sessions loading the Trebol package: it starts near 325,000 estimated tokens and targets 330,000, summarizes via the active model with one continuation at the turn boundary, and falls back to Pi native compaction when usage is unknown or the model window is below target. It is explicitly not a provider-enforced hard cap.

`ask_user_question` is an in-tree fork under `extensions/ask-user/` (registered in `extensions/ask-user/src/ask-tool.ts`) with the questionnaire schema; AGENTS.md states the former ask tool's automatic consultation is not supported in the replacement.
The running-work drawer shows bash items as one-line previews via `runningWorkListLabel` (control characters stripped, default 36-char limit), while non-bash items keep `kind label` form.
`runningWorkFooterHints` advertises `Ctrl+B detach/wait` only when a background-detach or wait function is registered on `globalThis` under the `pi-swarm-*` symbols.
`RunningWorkView` in `.pi/lib/ui/running-work-view.ts` is a read-only work browser; its test asserts the custom UI is opened without overlay options so Pi replaces the prompt editor.
`parseSubagentConversation` projects only `user`, `assistant`, and `toolResult` messages into steps, skipping other roles and malformed lines.
The running-work transcript reader parses only the last 512 KiB of a subagent transcript (`readSubagentConversation`), at most 200 lines, and keeps at most 80 steps (`steps.slice(-80)`).

`handleRunningWorkInput` opens the work view on Down (via Pi's `matchesKey(data, "down")`) only when the editor text is empty and browsable running work exists; the test opens a completed item with `\x1b[1;1B`.
